kill.root_cause: Word-SET recovery is exact (P/R=1.0); ORDER + MULTIPLICITY are lost. Bag-code structure: duplicates collapse to one signature (decode dedups), so exact-sequence comparison can never be 1 when a word repeats (every real window repeats 'the' etc.). Bigram beam DP over a deduped word set cannot reconstruct the sequence. Count information survives pre-normalization (signed accumulate) but v5's support-membership gate discards it.

v6_requirement: Count-aware decode (magnitude -> multiplicity) + order via directed bigram chain with multiplicity; NEW prereg required. K5 codec inversion remains FALSIFIED (address-space collapse 8192/65536, sealed same date).
